name: AADInternals
what: A PowerShell module for administering and researching Entra ID and Microsoft 365. It exposes many undocumented or portal-hidden operations that identity engineers and pentesters use for deep tenant reviews.
when: When portal clicks are not enough: verifying federation settings, application credentials, sync artefacts or other Entra configuration details during an authorized assessment.
example: On an approved Windows admin workstation: `Install-Module AADInternals` from the PowerShell Gallery.
Import the module and authenticate with the method that matches your test account (see the AADInternals documentation).
Run only the read-oriented cmdlets listed in the engagement plan first; escalate to write cmdlets only with a change ticket.
Record every cmdlet and tenant ID in the engagement log and revoke any temporary consent when finished.
pitfalls: Several cmdlets can change federation, credentials or sync behaviour; treat write actions as production changes.
EDR and cloud logs will show unusual Graph and AD-related traffic; notify the SOC.
Keep the module updated from the official gallery/GitHub; random mirrors are a supply-chain risk.
